p.s: Dear sir,
I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the musical show which the Circle Threatre has presented.
I recently had a week's holiday in London and during my stay I came to your threatre to see the "Over the Rainbow".
My evening was very disappointing.
In the advertisment, I had read that Danny Brook was starring but she was not.
A different actor was playing durring the musical and he was very disappointing.
The play should start at 19.30 but it started forty-five minutes later, we were waitting over there with out doing anything.
We got very bored and tired.
After the show had finished I went to the theatre restaurand to hav something to drink and get relaxed but it was closed because the stuff was on holiday.
Moreover the discounts were not available as you say in the advertisment and I paid £20.
I would like some refand because
It was one of the worst evenings in my life it if this matter does not solve I will go further.
I hope that it will be solved properly
Yours faithfully,
